provenance.metrics_protocol: hard_metrics were measured against the TRAINING background bank, before the disjoint evaluation bank existed. They are not comparable with hard numbers produced after that change - re-run notebook 06 to refresh them.

index_scope: The served index covers the whole catalogue, because a customer must be able to find anything the shop stocks. The 15% product-level holdout is a property of the measurement, not of the shop, so the evaluation index excludes it and every reported metric is computed against that smaller index.

hard_metrics_disjoint.background_bank: eval (checker, stripes) - never generated in training
hard_metrics_disjoint.note: Measured at a compositing scale of 0.55-1.00 against the notebook's 0.35-0.95, so it is not directly comparable with hard_metrics; it is reported because hard_metrics were measured against the training background bank and are circular.
